title: DeepMind Institute argues intelligence will emerge from networks of people and agents
friendlyTitle: Future AI may work as a team, not as one giant brain
summary: A new essay argues that advanced AI may emerge through coordinated systems of models, tools, institutions and people rather than one all-purpose model. It says the difficult work will be designing roles, rules and accountability for these mixed networks.
friendlySummary: DeepMind Institute says powerful AI may come from many people, models and tools working together. The rules for how they cooperate will be very important.
whyItMatters: For organisations adopting agents, the system around the model may matter as much as model intelligence. Clear boundaries, review points and responsibility become operational design requirements, not optional governance paperwork.
friendlyWhyItMatters: When you use AI agents, you need clear jobs, checks and responsibility. A smart model alone is not enough to make a safe and useful system.
